title: Scalar Curvature Question [?13]: [∗] no closed aspherical15 manifold admits a metric withSc > 0
exact_target: Must every closed smooth aspherical manifold admit no Riemannian metric of strictly positive scalar curvature? Aspherical means that the universal cover is contractible.
